problem_definition: Given a farm's soil, climate, location, season and available farming constraints, rank the most suitable crops for that farm.

anant.model: Various (Random Forest, Decision Tree, Naive Bayes)

datasets.kaggle_2200: Original Kaggle dataset. Perfectly balanced. Widely considered synthetic/interpolated.
datasets.anant_69k: Synthetically exploded version of Kaggle dataset. Massive leakage.
datasets.sheshank_regional: Real historical frequency data for Maharashtra districts/seasons.

crop_strategy.future_extensibility: Model versioning and crop catalogue updates

decisions.primary_ml_model: REJECT (Baseline Kaggle RF is too synthetic. Use APY regression approach instead)
decisions.kruthik_dataset: MODIFY (Can be used as a structural baseline, but not for production)
decisions.sheshank_regional_layer: MODIFY (Formula is useful statistical baseline for Maharashtra)
decisions.features: MODIFY (NPK+Climate is good, need to add real geographic features)
decisions.deployment_code: MODIFY (Gradio app is good for prototyping, need FastAPI for production)

risks: Overfitting to perfectly balanced synthetic Kaggle data (99% accuracy is a mirage).
Anant dataset suffers from severe data leakage.
Regional scoring is a statistical formula, not true ML, meaning it doesn't learn feature interactions.
No true real-world soil/climate field dataset found yet (all point back to Kaggle).
Missing geographic mapping (State/District) in the soil datasets.
